decisions: Cohere white, near-black, stone, deep green and restrained action blue; muted text darkened for legibility.
Use documented open-source Space Grotesk and Inter fallbacks, bundled locally with OFL licenses; Chinese uses system fonts.
Apply Google-style task priority, progressive disclosure, recovery and fast feedback without framework migration or dashboard-specific density.
Default appearance follows OS; user can choose light or dark and persist choice.
Session-scoped page drafts, details and reading position; explicit clear with undo, no server transmission.
